title: I used ChatGPT and Claude to build a gothic action-platformer prototype completely using AI. Here’s Crimson Ruin.
author: BeingComfortablyDumb
selftext:
I've been experimenting with how far I can take a game idea alone using an AI-assisted workflow. This is my 5th game and my biggest game in terms of scope. I'm still learning so any advice and suggestions are much appreciated!

This is Crimson Ruin, a 2D gothic action-platformer featuring a whip-wielding vampire. The current prototype has a playable level, 2 mini boss fights and a main boss fight.

I used ChatGPT and Claude alongside other AI tools like Eleven Labs, ComfyUI to help build and iterate on the game. My role has been choosing the direction, establishing the pipeline and workflows, testing the results, debugging and deciding what needs to change. This took about a week and half to complete.

This is an AI-assisted prototype with placeholder assets, not a finished commercial game. If it gets funding and moves forward, the game will be reworked entirely with human designers. I am still not happy with the results since it isn't exactly how I hoped it would be. I don't want to build a half-assed game. Me with AI can do half the work. Make a prototype, design level layouts, mechanics, feel and experience of the game while the designers actually help bring it to life and provide insights which I don't have.

Most people using AI would start a Kickstarter campaign trying to raise funds based on an AI prototype with unpolished, unfinished gameplay. I actually want to polish to demo itself first before even thinking about doing a Kickstarter campaign or a Steam Wishlist page by having people test it out and give feedback. Also have the placeholder assets replaced hopefully but that's expensive :'( (Unless I find a 2D guy)

This post is less a promotion and more an appeal to like-minded creative people who don't hate AI. I would really love to work with other people using AI to build something that others would enjoy and not just ourselves. Anyone wanting to work together please feel free to DM.

Please give it a try and let me know what you think of it.

You can play the demo here on Itch.io: [https://mythicmotion.itch.io/crimson-ruin](https://mythicmotion.itch.io/crimson-ruin)

You can also play it here on my own website and try out the other games I've made aswell: [https://games.mythicmotion.in/play/crimson-ruin/](https://games.mythicmotion.in/play/crimson-ruin/)
